name: whatsapp-unofficial
description: Unofficial, community-built WhatsApp integration: read your own WhatsApp chats from Claude Code via a local linked device. Read-only by default; sending is opt-in. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.

allow_send.title: Allow sending messages
allow_send.description: Off by default. When on, Claude gets send_message, send_file and send_audio_message tools that send real WhatsApp messages from your account to your contacts. Messages cannot be unsent by the plugin, automated sending may get your number banned by WhatsApp, and a malicious incoming message could try to trick Claude into sending. Only enable this if you need it, and review every send.
